input.rationale: Section 9 is limited to mutual corporate authority representations (p0056–p0057) plus a Globix carve-out (p0058); there is no express warranty that HDI's site development and hosting Services will be performed in a workmanlike manner, that the Site will conform to the approved specifications, or any repair/re-performance/refund remedy. Sections 1 and 5 impose delivery and operational obligations on HDI but no quality warranty (the only quality-adjacent right is termination if the Site is not operational within 70 days, p0011). There is no "AS IS" or implied-warranty disclaimer, so inserting the express warranty does not require a disclaimer carve-out. We therefore insert a new Section 9(c) with the preferred warranty package (workmanlike Services, 12-month Site conformance, legal compliance, no malicious code) and a repair/re-performance/refund remedy, noting the 90/30-day fallback.

proposal.summary: Add an HDI performance warranty for the Site and hosting Services, with a repair/re-performance/refund remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual authority representations, so we added an express performance warranty from HDI covering workmanlike Services, conformance of the Site for twelve months, legal compliance and no malicious code, with a repair, re-performance or refund remedy. This is our standard position for development and hosting work; we can accept a ninety (90) day conformance period for the Site and thirty (30) days for Services if HDI needs a shorter tail.

ops.text: (c) HDI represents and warrants to the Company that (1) all Services, including the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (2) for a period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Site will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation approved by the Company pursuant to Section 5.2; (3) the Services and the Site will comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software or tools provided by HDI hereunder will not contain any virus, worm, disabling device or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at HDI's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services or repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site, or, if HDI fails to do so within thirty (30) days of the Company's notice, a refund of the fees paid to HDI in respect of the non-conforming Services or Site.
